title: Notion Knowledge Hub
description: My complete central database of engineering notes, system design papers, and programming guides, embedded directly from my Notion workspace.

title: When the Gateway Times Out: Idempotent Payment Design
description: A ₦50,000 withdrawal. A timed-out gateway. Funds that may have already left the account — but the system shows FAILED. This article breaks down how to design payment systems that guarantee no duplicate payouts, no lost funds, and correct reconciliation. Core principle: delayed truth over incorrect truth.

title: How Not to Buy a Scammer Coffee
description: Building a fraud-resistant financial system taught me how real-world exploits happen — and how to stop them. From card testing to multi-account attacks, I share the exact patterns we observed and the systems we built to protect every naira, automatically and in real time.

title: How We Built a Hybrid WebRTC Calling System Inside a Mobile WebView
description: WebRTC was supposed to be the universal answer for real-time audio/video — not if your app lives inside a mobile WebView. I break down how we built PopnChat's calling system: why we wrote WebRTC logic twice (TypeScript + Java), how we kept signaling in JS while native code owned the media, and the specific bugs that only appear on real devices.

title: The Floating-Point Bomb: Why Your Finance App Is Probably Losing Money
description: If your fintech app uses floating-point numbers for money, it is already leaking value. Floating-point precision errors silently break wallets, audits, refunds, and compliance. The only safe approach is integer-based currency handling (kobo/cents) with centralized logic — this is not an optimization, it is a requirement.
